hcontainer.p: (2) The Commission has, in numerous decisions, clarified the notion of aid within the meaning of Article 107(1) of the Treaty. The Commission has also stated its policy on a de minimis ceiling below which Article 107(1) of the Treaty may be considered not to apply. It did so initially in its notice on the de minimis rule for State aid (2) and subsequently in Commission Regulations (EC) No 69/2001 (3), (EC) No 1998/2006 (4) and (EU) No 1407/2013 (5). This Regulation replaces Regulation (EU) No 1407/2013 upon its expiry.
